# ELS Agent Practices

> AGENTS.md for empirical legal research: standing instructions for AI coding agents working on empirical legal studies projects, plus a guide that explains the reason behind each rule. Versions 0.0.x are comment drafts; each published version is a frozen snapshot, and the draft changes often.

- [AGENTS.md, latest published version (save in a project folder as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md)](latest/AGENTS.md)
- [The guide, latest published version](latest/agent-best-practices.md)
- [All published versions](versions.json)
- [Working draft of AGENTS.md](draft/AGENTS.md)
- [Working draft of the guide](draft/agent-best-practices.md)
